entries.symptom: errSecInternalComponent from codesign during the archive
entries.cause: The login keychain is locked (an SSH or other non-GUI session)
entries.fix: Stop: the developer unlocks the keychain or starts the run from the desktop; never retry; then rerun with --resume build (same build number, nothing uploaded)

entries.symptom: A macOS dialog: "codesign wants to access key ..."
entries.cause: The key's access list does not include codesign yet
entries.fix: Stop: the developer clicks Always Allow once

entries.symptom: No profiles for '<bundle id>' were found, or Automatic signing is disabled
entries.cause: -allowProvisioningUpdates or the three -authenticationKey* flags are missing, or DEVELOPMENT_TEAM is empty
entries.fix: Pass the API-key flags to xcodebuild; export APPLE_TEAM_ID before prebuild so app.config.ts writes ios.appleTeamId

entries.symptom: The first archive with the API key cannot create the Apple Development certificate
entries.cause: Not verified whether an API key alone can create it on a new machine
entries.fix: Human step: the developer signs in once in Xcode > Settings > Accounts, then rerun

entries.symptom: An error that mentions an agreement (altool, App Store Connect API) or "PLA Update available" (xcodebuild)
entries.cause: A new or expired Apple agreement
entries.fix: Stop: the developer accepts it in App Store Connect; then rerun with --resume build if the stop came before the upload, otherwise a plain rerun

entries.symptom: The upload cannot determine the Apple ID for the bundle ID, or no App Store Connect app record exists
entries.cause: The app record does not exist, and the public API cannot create apps
entries.fix: Stop: the developer creates it (My Apps > + > New App), then rerun
match: No App Store Connect app record

entries.symptom: NOT_AUTHORIZED (401) from altool or the App Store Connect REST API
entries.cause: A wrong key or issuer id, a revoked key, or clock skew (a token issued in the future)
entries.fix: Stop: check the key and issuer ids against the key file name without reading the key, and that the clock is on network time; a revoked key needs a new team key from the developer

entries.symptom: FORBIDDEN_ERROR (403), or "not allowed to create distribution certificates"
entries.cause: The API key role is below Admin, or it is an individual key
entries.fix: Stop: the developer creates a team key with the Admin role

entries.symptom: App Store Connect rejects a token that looks valid
entries.cause: A token that expires more than 20 minutes after its issue time is invalid; a stale clock also breaks the issue time
entries.fix: Sign tokens for 15 minutes and create a fresh one per request during long waits

entries.symptom: Build processing state INVALID or FAILED
entries.cause: Apple rejected the binary during processing
entries.fix: Stop: ask the developer to forward Apple's email; fix the cause, then rebuild with a new build number

entries.symptom: ITMS-90189: Redundant Binary Upload
entries.cause: The build number was reused
entries.fix: Never reuse or roll back a number: bump and rebuild (check the earlier upload's processing first)

entries.symptom: ITMS-90062: version must be higher than the previously approved version
entries.cause: The version was not raised after an approval
entries.fix: Raise the version in app.config.ts and rebuild

entries.symptom: ITMS-90683: Missing purpose string in Info.plist (for example NSMicrophoneUsageDescription)
entries.cause: A linked library references a protected API (an audio library's record-permission API), so Apple requires the usage string even if the app never asks
entries.fix: Add a neutral, translated usage string through the library's config plugin option, or block the API in the plugin when the app never uses it; rebuild with a new build number

entries.symptom: ITMS-91053 (missing API declaration), ITMS-91061 (missing privacy manifest for an SDK) or ITMS-91056 (invalid manifest)
entries.cause: The aggregated required-reason APIs are incomplete; Apple does not reliably read the manifests of static pods
entries.fix: Aggregate every pod manifest into ios.privacyManifests (the privacy audit fails on a gap), prebuild, rebuild with a new build number

entries.symptom: altool --upload-package --wait (or eas submit) returned, but the build is not in TestFlight
entries.cause: They return once the build is PROCESSING, not VALID
entries.fix: Poll the processing state (REST) every 60 s for up to 60 minutes; done only at VALID

entries.symptom: Processing did not reach VALID within 60 minutes
entries.cause: Apple is slow, or the build is stuck
entries.fix: Check the TestFlight tab, then rerun with --resume processing (the upload is done; a plain rerun would upload a second build)

entries.symptom: The release stops after the upload while waiting for processing, or reading the processing state failed
entries.cause: A REST error (401/403 or no network) while polling; the build is already at Apple
entries.fix: A 401 or 403 is a stop for the developer; otherwise restore the network. Then rerun with --resume processing

entries.symptom: release --resume stops: cannot resume (HEAD is not the build-number commit, or that build is already tagged)
entries.cause: A commit came after the build-number bump (usually the fix itself), or that build already finished
entries.fix: Rerun without --resume; it takes a new build number (gaps are harmless, Apple rejects only duplicates)

entries.symptom: The build is VALID but does not appear in TestFlight on a tester's phone
entries.cause: TestFlight shows a build only to testers in a group that has it; the app has no internal group with automatic distribution
entries.fix: Human step: the developer creates an internal testing group with automatic distribution and adds the testers; later builds then appear without another step

entries.symptom: A first in-app purchase cannot be submitted on its own
entries.cause: The first in-app purchase must be submitted together with a new app version
entries.fix: Human step: the developer selects the purchase on the version page before Submit for Review; later purchases can be submitted alone

entries.symptom: App Store Connect offers no store localization for one of the app's languages
entries.cause: Apple's store localization list does not cover every language an app can ship
entries.fix: Store texts use the closest supported store languages; the in-app languages are unaffected

entries.symptom: The exported build has other version or build numbers than app.config.ts
entries.cause: manageAppVersionAndBuildNumber defaults to YES in ExportOptions
entries.fix: Set manageAppVersionAndBuildNumber to false in every export-options plist

entries.symptom: xcodebuild warns that the export method app-store is deprecated
entries.cause: The ExportOptions method was renamed
entries.fix: Use method app-store-connect (destination export, signingStyle automatic)

entries.symptom: The store-artifact gate fails on the exported .ipa or .aab
entries.cause: The artifact holds test-only code, a test artefact (StoreKit configuration, harness), a sample ad id, a placeholder, a stale build number or a debug entitlement
entries.fix: Fix the cause the gate names and rebuild with a new build number; never skip the gate or upload the artifact anyway

entries.symptom: grep finds Google's sample publisher id 3940256099942544 in every production bundle
entries.cause: react-native-google-mobile-ads ships its TestIds module in every bundle
entries.fix: Check the sample id on the source-mapped export with node_modules excluded; the binary gate checks the native app id and the test-only sentinel instead

entries.symptom: A ship gate prints [ship-placeholder] lines: a com.example.* id, a Google sample AdMob app or unit id, example.com or an @example.com address, or an unfilled `__UPPER_SNAKE__` token
entries.cause: The real identifiers (bundle id, ad ids, privacy-policy URL, support address) were never supplied; every ship gate refuses each placeholder by name
entries.fix: Stop: the developer supplies the real values, then write them into app.config.ts and the contracts; never edit a gate or the placeholder list to pass, and never type a stand-in value

entries.symptom: The store gate fails its signing rule (the app is not signed, codesign -d failed) on an archive built with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
entries.cause: Ship gates require a signed export; a keyless rehearsal archive has none
entries.fix: For a rehearsal only pass --rehearsal: the gate prints REHEARSAL: not a release gate and skips only the signing rule. A rehearsal is never release evidence

entries.symptom: A JWT, an Authorization header or private key text appears in a log, a report or a commit
entries.cause: Debug output or a copy of the key
entries.fix: Stop: the developer revokes the key, creates a new one and replaces the file; search git log -p -S for the key header and the reports folder

entries.symptom: A build reached TestFlight or Play without the store gate having read it (eas build --auto-submit, eas submit --latest)
entries.cause: The submit took whatever EAS built last instead of the artifact the gate passed
entries.fix: Download the artifact, run the gate on it, then eas submit --path <that file>; --auto-submit only for iOS when the gate runs on the EAS record

entries.symptom: eas build offers to generate a new keystore (or certificate) for an app that is already in the store
entries.cause: The EAS project lost its credentials (another account or project)
entries.fix: Stop: restore the original credentials into EAS (eas credentials); build with --freeze-credentials so a non-interactive build never replaces them

entries.symptom: The AAB gate or the release setup check fails target-sdk: targetSdkVersion (or compileSdkVersion) is <n>, below <Play floor>
entries.cause: An expo-build-properties override (android.targetSdkVersion or compileSdkVersion) or a config plugin lowered the level the Expo SDK sets
entries.fix: Remove the override and prebuild with --clean; keep compileSdk and targetSdk from the Expo SDK (36). Play refuses new apps and updates below its floor, so never ship the lower level

entries.symptom: The Play upload stops: api-not-enabled (HTTP 403); Google says SERVICE_DISABLED or "Google Play Android Developer API has not been used in project <n> before or it is disabled"
entries.cause: The Google Play Android Developer API is off in the Google Cloud project that owns the service account
entries.fix: Stop: the developer enables the API in that Cloud project (it takes a few minutes to apply); never retry before they confirm, then rerun the same upload command
match: Android Developer API has not been used in project

entries.symptom: The Play upload (or eas submit) stops: auth (HTTP 401 or 403): "The caller does not have permission", "Permission ... denied by IAM policy" or "Request had invalid authentication credentials"
entries.cause: The service account is not invited to this app in Play Console (Users and permissions), lacks the release permission for the track, or its JSON key was deleted or revoked
entries.fix: Stop: the developer grants the service account access to this app with release rights for the track, or makes a new JSON key; never retry, never open or print the key file
match: The caller does not have permission

entries.symptom: The Play upload stops: app-not-found (HTTP 404), or eas submit says "Package not found: <package>"
entries.cause: No app with this package name exists in Play Console yet, or its first build was never uploaded by hand: the Play API can neither create an app nor make its first upload
entries.fix: Stop: the developer creates the app in Play Console and uploads the first .aab to internal testing by hand (the release skill names the bundle); automated uploads work from the second build on

entries.symptom: Only releases with status draft may be created on draft app (the upload stops: draft-app)
entries.cause: The Play app is still a draft (store listing or App content never completed), so Play accepts only draft releases
entries.fix: Stop and ask: with the developer's word upload as a draft (--draft-app, or releaseStatus "draft" in eas.json submit) and the developer rolls it out in Play Console; or the developer finishes the store setup first
match: Only releases with status draft may be created on draft app

entries.symptom: The Play upload stops: policy-declarations; Google names a declaration ("You must complete the advertising ID declaration", Data safety, content rating, target audience, privacy policy)
entries.cause: App content in Play Console is incomplete; Play answers some of these with 403, which is not a permission problem
entries.fix: Stop: the developer completes the declaration Google names in App content (privacy-and-store-declarations keeps the answers); rerun the same upload once it is done

entries.symptom: Changes cannot be sent for review automatically. Please set the query parameter changesNotSentForReview to true
entries.cause: An earlier update was rejected, or the app's changes are held for review by hand, so Play will not send this edit for review by itself
entries.fix: Stop: the developer decides. With their word, run the same command again with --changes-not-sent-for-review (eas.json submit: changesNotSentForReview true), then the developer sends the changes for review in Play Console (Publishing overview)
match: Changes cannot be sent for review automatically

entries.symptom: The Play upload stops on a network error or a timeout
entries.cause: The machine is offline, or Google answered too slowly
entries.fix: Ask before one retry; a half-done Play edit expires by itself and the gated bundle is unchanged, so the retry uploads the same file

entries.symptom: Internal or closed testers do not see the build on Google Play
entries.cause: They are not on the track's testers list, have not opted in through the track's link, or are signed in to Play with another Google account than the one on the list
entries.fix: Human step: the developer adds the tester's Google account to the list and shares the opt-in link; the tester opens it signed in with that same account. Nothing in the build changes
